promotions.description: Ant Bank's savings account has been upgraded to support multiple currencies including Hong Kong Dollar, Renminbi and US Dollar. Customers can manage all their currencies in one account for greater convenience.

promotions.title: Time Deposit with Early Withdrawal Without Penalty

promotions.description: Ant Bank allows customers to withdraw their time deposits before maturity without incurring any penalty fees. promotions.title: Investment Fund - HKD 1 Minimum Subscription

promotions.title: Investment Account Opening in 1 Minute
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open an investment account in as fast as 1 minute
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers a seamless investment account opening experience that can be completed in as little as 1 minute. No income proof required, allowing customers to start investing immediately after account opening.

promotions.title: One-Stop Hong Kong and US Stock Trading Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Trade Hong Kong and US stocks in one platform
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers a one-stop trading platform connecting Hong Kong and US stock markets. The platform provides global investment solutions including Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, ETFs, and more.

promotions.title: Time Deposit with Low Minimum Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💲 Time deposits starting from as low as HKD 1
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers time deposits with an extremely low minimum amount of just HKD 1. This makes time deposits accessible to all customers regardless of their savings amount, allowing everyone to enjoy higher interest rates.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Time deposits available in both HKD and USD
promotions.description: Ant Bank's time deposit service supports both Hong Kong dollars and US dollars. This gives customers the flexibility to earn interest on their deposits in different currencies according to their financial needs.

promotions.title: Guaranteed Safe Deposit Service

promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched the Safe Lock Deposit Service, an anti-fraud measure initiated by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. This service allows customers to lock their spare deposits, preventing transfers through any channels to reduce the risk of fraud.

promotions.title: Ant Bank Investment Fund Platform Transaction Fee Waiver

promotions.description: Customers can enjoy fee waivers on fund subscriptions and redemptions on Ant Bank's new investment fund platform. The bank does not charge any platform fees, offering a truly zero-cost investment experience.

promotions.title: Increased Daily Transfer Limit

promotions.description: Ant Bank has increased the daily transfer limit to up to HKD 1 million. Customers can now transfer larger amounts directly from Libra Savings to third-party accounts through the Ant Bank APP.

promotions.title: Secure Deposit Protection Service

promotions.title: Regular Fund Investment Feature
promotions.highlight: 📈 Set up regular investments from HKD 1
promotions.description: Ant Bank's new regular fund investment feature allows customers to set up periodic investments with amounts as low as HKD 1. This feature helps diversify risk and smooth out market volatility through dollar-cost averaging.

promotions.title: Insurance Products with Annual Rate up to 3.6%

promotions.description: Customers can open an investment account in as little as 1 minute through the Ant Bank app or AlipayHK mini app. The streamlined process requires no income proof and offers immediate access to investment services after completion.

promotions.title: Investment Account Opening in 1 Minute

promotions.title: Insurance Products with up to 3.6% Annualized Rate

promotions.title: One-Stop Hong Kong and US Stock Trading Platform

promotions.quota: Available to Hong Kong residents only

promotions.title: Tax Deduction for Wang Fuk Court Support Fund Donations
promotions.highlight: 💝 Special tax deduction arrangement for Support Fund donations
promotions.description: Donations made to the Support Fund for Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po through bank transfer with an amount of HK$50,000 or below are eligible for tax deductions without requiring official receipts. Donors need to retain relevant donation records for potential review by the Inland Revenue Department.

promotions.title: liviSave No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 💸 No fees and no minimum deposit requirements
promotions.description: Open a liviSave account without worrying about fees or minimum balance requirements. This account caters to both paying and saving needs, offering complete flexibility for customers.

promotions.title: Money Safe Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Special rewards for keeping your money safe
promotions.description: livi offers 'Money Safe Rewards' (智安存獎賞) program that provides benefits to customers for maintaining security measures. This program rewards customers for practicing safe banking habits.

promotions.title: No Minimum Deposit Requirement
promotions.highlight: 🆓 No fees and no minimum balance requirements
promotions.description: Open and maintain a liviSave account with no minimum deposit requirement and no maintenance fees. This feature makes the account accessible to everyone regardless of their financial situation.

promotions.title: Instant Loan with Interest Rate as Low as 1.18% and up to HKD10,888 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💸 Get a personal loan with attractive rates as low as 1.18% and earn up to HKD12,888 cash reward
promotions.description: Mox is offering instant personal loans with rates as low as 1.18% APR. The entire application process can be completed within the Mox app, from personalized quotation to instant disbursement. Customers who successfully apply for a designated Instant Loan from now until 31 July 2026 can enjoy up to HKD12,888 in cash rewards. The process is designed to be seamless, giving customers quick access to the cash they need.

promotions.title: Keeta Order Exclusive Flash Sale with up to HKD80 Discount
promotions.highlight: ⚡️ Enjoy up to HKD20 off per order, saving up to HKD80 for the whole month
promotions.description: Mox Card users can enjoy exclusive discounts when ordering from Keeta until April 30, 2026. The promotion offers up to HKD20 off per order, with potential savings of up to HKD80 throughout the month. In addition to the discount, customers can also receive surprise vouchers and welcome rewards to enhance their home dining experience. This exclusive offer is only available when using a Mox Card for payment on the Keeta platform, making home parties both more economical and rewarding for Mox customers.

promotions.title: Mox Journey from Scratch Promotion with Rewards up to HKD8,888
promotions.highlight: 💥 Scratch to win rewards worth up to HKD8,888 by completing investment missions
promotions.description: During the promotional period, customers can take on any of five simple investment challenges to receive a Mox Scratch Card. Upon completion of each task, customers can scratch and instantly reveal their prize. The more missions completed, the higher the chance to win the top prize of HKD8,888 (consisting of HKD8,000 in SOL (Solana) plus HKD888 cash reward). This promotion has limited quota and operates on a first-come, first-served basis. The promotion runs from March 16, 2026, to June 15, 2026.

promotions.title: Mox x csl Best-in-Town Exclusive Plan with up to HKD1,380 Rebates + Free NowTV Pass
promotions.highlight: 🤳 Get up to HKD1,380 rebates on new sign-ups or renewals + a free NowTV Pass
promotions.description: Mox and csl have partnered to offer the 'Best-in-Town' exclusive plan for telecommunications services. Customers who sign up for a new plan or renew an existing one with Mox Credit Card autopay will automatically enjoy an HKD180 monthly fee rebate plus a free Now TV beIN SPORTS Super Pack 1-Month Pass, valued at HKD188. This offer enhances both connectivity and entertainment services in a single package, providing excellent value for Mox customers.
promotions.cost: Sign-up or renewal of csl plan required

promotions.title: Travel Pick & Go Eggstra Care+ Free Add-on Coverage
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Get FREE add-on coverage with Travel Pick & Go insurance
promotions.description: From March 4 to May 31, 2026, customers who apply for Travel Pick & Go insurance will receive one FREE add-on coverage of their choice. This promotion aims to help travelers safeguard their trips from the financial stress that unexpected events can bring. The free add-on coverage enhances the base travel insurance policy, providing extra peace of mind for travelers. This offer is Mox's way of helping customers protect their vacations while enjoying their travel experiences without worry.
promotions.cost: Purchase of Travel Pick & Go insurance required

promotions.title: Mox Travel Welcome Offer with up to 28,500 Miles
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to 28,500 miles through spending and saving
promotions.description: New customers who enter the invitation code MOXTRAVEL when opening a Mox account and apply for a Mox Credit Card can earn up to 28,500 miles through a combination of spending and saving activities. This miles offering is substantial enough for a round-trip flight to destinations within Asia, making it an attractive proposition for travel enthusiasts. The promotion runs until June 30, 2026, giving potential customers ample time to take advantage of this offer. The miles can be used within participating airline frequent flyer programs, providing flexibility for travel redemptions.
promotions.cost: Account opening and credit card application required

promotions.title: Mox x The Club Samsung S26 Series HKD100 Off Exclusive Offer
promotions.highlight: 📱 Get HKD100 off the new Samsung S26 series exclusively
promotions.description: Mox is offering an exclusive HKD100 discount on the new Samsung S26 series when purchased through The Club. This limited-time promotion allows customers to upgrade to the latest flagship smartphone while enjoying special savings. The offer is exclusive to Mox customers, providing a unique benefit for those looking to purchase the new Samsung devices. Customers will need to use their Mox Card for payment to take advantage of this exclusive discount. This promotion represents a partnership between Mox and The Club to provide added value to customers interested in new technology products.
promotions.cost: Purchase of Samsung S26 series required

promotions.title: Uber Taxi Spending Reward - HKD10 Off Per Ride
promotions.highlight: 🚕 Enjoy HKD10 off each Uber Taxi ride per month
promotions.description: Mox Card users can enjoy discounts on their Uber Taxi rides until April 30, 2026. The promotion offers HKD10 off each Uber Taxi ride per month when paid with a Mox Card. This offer applies to various ride purposes, whether visiting family, going out for weekend activities, or heading to the airport. Customers need to claim an exclusive promo code to activate this discount. The offer helps customers save money on their transportation expenses while encouraging the use of their Mox Card for everyday transactions.
promotions.quota: Monthly limit of HKD10 off per ride
promotions.cost: Uber Taxi ride payment with Mox Card

promotions.description: Open a Mox Account with the invitation code 'MOXPAYROLL' by 30 June 2026 and earn HKD400 when your credit card is approved within the following 30 days. Additionally, accumulate eligible payroll transactions in May and June 2026 to earn HKD600 each month, for a total of up to HKD1,600 in cash rewards. This offer is exclusively available to customers who have not held any Mox Account in their name at any time during the 12 months prior to the onboarding date.

This offer is only applicable to customers who have not held any Mox Account in their name during the 12 months prior to onboarding.

Furthermore, customers can earn a total welcome savings rate of 12% p.a. from deposits. This makes everyday activities significantly more rewarding for new customers who take advantage of this promotion.

This promotion transforms the routine expense of bill payment into an opportunity to earn rewards. In addition to the special promotion rewards, customers can still earn the standard up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on their bill payments, maximizing the value of necessary expenses.

This year-long promotion is designed specifically for Mox customers, allowing them to save money and earn rewards while booking travel arrangements. The combined benefits make this an attractive offer for frequent travelers who want to maximize their savings on travel expenses.

This flexible program allows customers to choose which missions to complete based on their banking habits, making it easy to enhance their savings rate.

promotions.title: Policy Loan Service
promotions.highlight: 🔐 Loans secured against insurance policy cash values
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers policy loans that allow customers to borrow against the cash value of their insurance policies. This provides a way to access liquidity while keeping insurance coverage intact.

promotions.title: Money Safe Feature
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Secure savings feature for better financial management
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Money Safe feature (智安存) provides a secure savings option for customers looking to protect and manage their funds. This feature helps customers save more effectively as part of the bank's comprehensive banking services.

promotions.title: Learn Now Pay Later Program
promotions.highlight: 🎓 Education financing with flexible payment options
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Learn Now Pay Later program offers financing options for education expenses. This allows customers to pay for courses or educational programs through installment payments rather than upfront lump sums.

promotions.title: Card Debt Consolidation Loan
promotions.highlight: 💳 Consolidate high-interest credit card debt at lower rates
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a specialized loan service for consolidating credit card debts. This allows customers to combine multiple high-interest credit card balances into a single loan with potentially lower interest rates and fixed monthly payments.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enhanced savings product with competitive interest rates
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's GoSave 2.0 is an upgraded savings product offering competitive interest rates. It's designed to help customers maximize their returns on deposits through the bank's digital platform.

promotions.title: Featured Funds Services with Over 170 Funds
promotions.highlight: 📊 Access to over 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Featured Funds Service provides access to over 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses. Customers can easily invest in popular mutual funds, dividend funds, bond funds and more with a simple interface showing trending investment ideas.
promotions.cost: Monthly platform fee of 0.1% based on fund holdings value

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card - $0 Foreign Currency Transaction Fee
promotions.highlight: 💳 Make global payments with competitive exchange rates using the Global Wallet Debit Card
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Global Wallet Debit Card allows customers to make international payments using funds from their WeLab Global Wallet. Users benefit from competitive exchange rates and seamless integration with the WeLab Bank app.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 Higher Interest Rate
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy higher deposit interest rates through AI-powered technology
promotions.description: GoSave 2.0 offers higher deposit interest rates than standard accounts by intelligently leveraging AI and technology. The service helps customers maximize their savings returns without complex requirements.

promotions.title: WeLab閒智寶
promotions.highlight: 📈 Money market fund with returns similar to time deposits
promotions.description: WeLab閒智寶 is a money market fund available through WeLab Bank's Featured Fund Services that aims to provide returns similar to time deposits without lock-in periods. It offered a one-year return of up to 4.4% as of March 31, 2026.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: 📈 Higher deposit rates leveraging AI and technology
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers GoSave 2.0 time deposits with competitive interest rates. The service intelligently uses AI and technology to provide better deposit rates compared to traditional banks.

promotions.title: Tesla Customer Exclusive Personal Instalment Loan Offer
promotions.highlight: 💸 Flexible personal loans with competitive interest rates
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers Personal Instalment Loans with competitive interest rates and flexible repayment terms. Customers can borrow funds for various purposes with a straightforward application process.

promotions.title: Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💼 Competitive time deposit rates
promotions.description: WeLab Bank provides time deposit services with competitive interest rates. Customers can lock in their funds for a fixed period to earn guaranteed returns higher than standard savings accounts.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Fund Investment Amount
promotions.highlight: 💰 Start investing with as little as HKD 100 or USD 15
promotions.description: WeLab Bank allows customers to start investing in funds with a minimum amount of just HKD 100 or USD 15 (for Featured Fund Service). This low entry barrier makes fund investment accessible to beginners and those looking to start with small amounts.
promotions.cost: Minimum investment of HKD 100 or USD 15

promotions.title: First-time Foreign Currency Exchange Cash Rebate
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Instant local money transfers
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers Faster Payment System (FPS) transfers allowing customers to send and receive money instantly within Hong Kong. This service is part of their core banking offering.

promotions.title: WeLab Fund Platform - Flat 0.1% Monthly Fee
promotions.highlight: 💰 Money market fund with same-day settlement
promotions.description: WeLab 閒智寶 is a money market fund theme in WeLab Bank's Featured Fund Service with same-day settlement. It offers returns comparable to time deposits without lock-in periods, with the top-performing fund showing a one-year return of up to 4.4%.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 Time Deposit 4% p.a. Interest Rate

promotions.description: GoSave 2.0 is WeLab Bank's time deposit offering that provides competitive interest rates for customer savings. It is mentioned as one of the core banking services offered by WeLab Bank.

promotions.title: Easter Lucky Draw & Cash Rebate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Win from 300 prizes including HKD1,000 travel vouchers
promotions.description: Get lucky draw chances by making foreign currency exchanges and spending with WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card. Automatic entry with eligible transactions during the promotion period. The more you spend, the higher your chances to win.
promotions.quota: 300 prizes in total, must have at least one eligible card transaction per round to participate

promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy up to HKD 5,000 cash rewards for new customers
promotions.description: New customers can enjoy a dual welcome offer including up to 4% p.a. time deposit rate and up to HKD 4,000 investment fund cash rewards. Use promo code 'WL5000' when opening an account to be eligible.
promotions.cost: Deposit and investment required for full rewards

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card - $0 Foreign Currency Transaction Fee
promotions.highlight: 💳 Enjoy $0 foreign currency transaction fees with supported currencies
promotions.description: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card offers $0 foreign currency transaction fees for 10 supported currencies including JPY, USD, CNY, AUD, GBP, EUR, SGD, CAD, CHF, and NZD. No markup on currency exchange when using the card overseas.

promotions.title: 50 Extra Lucky Draw Chances for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 🎲 New customers receive 50 additional lucky draw chances
promotions.description: New customers get 50 extra chances to participate in the lucky draw promotion when using Global Wallet Debit Card for overseas spending. This is in addition to the automatic entry and 3% cashback on overseas transactions.

promotions.title: 50 Extra Lucky Draw Chances for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 🎲 New customers get 50 extra lucky draw entries
promotions.description: New customers can receive 50 additional lucky draw chances for the Easter Lucky Draw promotion. Combined with overseas spending rebates, new customers can maximize their rewards when using the Global Wallet Debit Card.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank New Customer 2-in-1 Welcome Offer
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy up to HKD 5,000 cash rewards with time deposit and investment
promotions.description: New customers who open an account with promo code 'WL5000' can enjoy dual welcome benefits: up to 4% p.a. time deposit interest rate and up to HKD 4,000 investment fund cash reward, totaling approximately HKD 5,000 in rewards.
promotions.cost: Requires time deposit placement and fund investment

promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD 800 for each successful Tesla loan referral
promotions.description: Customers can refer friends who are Tesla owners to apply for WeLab Bank personal instalment loan with promo code 'TESLA5' to enjoy the special 4.55% APR offer. For each successful referral, the referrer will receive HKD 800 cash reward.
promotions.quota: Up to 10 successful referrals per customer (maximum HKD 8,000 reward)

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Fund Subscription Fee Offer until 31 Jul 2026
promotions.highlight: 💼 0% subscription fees on ALL funds with no cap
promotions.description: From now until 31 July 2026, retail banking users who have activated investment fund trading services with ZA Bank can enjoy a 0% fund subscription fee offer and redemption fee waivers for all funds. This offer allows investors to have 100% of their money go into the market without paying any subscription fees, regardless of the fund amount. The promotion applies to all funds available on the ZA Bank platform. To take advantage of this offer, customers need to have an active ZA Bank account with investment fund trading services activated.

promotions.title: ZA Bank New Customer 20% p.a. HKD Time Deposit Offer (Deposit Condition)
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest rate on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New customers who open a ZA Bank account using a referral code and meet the deposit condition can receive a +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD new funds time deposit interest rate booster coupon. When combined with the base interest rate, this offers a total of 20% annual interest rate. The deposit condition requires making a single deposit of at least HKD 1,000 from a non-ZA Bank account within 14 days of account opening. The coupon can be applied to new funds up to HKD 20,000. The booster coupon must be claimed from ZA Quest within 7 days of meeting the condition and is valid for 7 days after claiming.

promotions.title: StockBack x ZA Card 1.5% Stock Rebate Offer
promotions.highlight: 📈 Earn stocks worth 1-2.5% of your spending when you use ZA Card
promotions.description: Earn stocks worth 1% of your spending amount on every qualifying transaction of HKD 10 or more with your ZA Card. Each qualifying transaction earns you one StockBack chance valid for 48 hours, allowing you to choose one stock from six options displayed on the StockBack machine. New users can enjoy up to 2.5% stock rebate for their first HKD 10,000 spending within 30 days of account opening. You must have an active investment account with the corresponding trading service activated within 90 days of selecting your reward to receive your stocks.
promotions.cost: Minimum spend of HKD 10 per transaction

promotions.title: New Account Bonus - Fund Holding Rebate Vouchers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 2.5% stock rebate on card spending for new customers
promotions.description: New customers who open a ZA Bank account using a referral code during the promotion period can enjoy a 2.5% stock rebate through the StockBack x ZA Card program. This increased rebate rate combines the standard 1.5% rebate with an additional 1% bonus for new users. To qualify, new customers must choose the StockBack x ZA Card reward plan and make qualifying purchases with their ZA Card. Each eligible transaction gives you a chance to select stocks from the StockBack machine to receive as a reward worth 2.5% of your transaction amount.

promotions.title: Year-Round Travel Offers with ZA Card
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Exclusive travel discounts and benefits for ZA Card holders
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides year-round travel offers for ZA Card holders, allowing customers to enjoy special discounts and benefits on travel-related expenses. These offers may include discounted hotel stays, special rates on flights, and exclusive packages for popular tourist destinations. The year-round nature of these offers means that ZA customers can benefit from travel savings regardless of when they plan their trips. No limited time period or special eligibility requirements are mentioned, making this a standard feature for ZA Card holders.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Card holders

promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a multi-currency savings account that allows customers to hold 11 different currencies in a single account, including HKD, CNY, USD, GBP, SGD, EUR, CAD, AUD, JPY, NZD, and CHF. Customers can manage their global assets through one app and enjoy the convenience of holding multiple currencies without the need for separate accounts. This is a permanent account feature with no end date or special eligibility requirements.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals at 3,000+ Visa ATMs in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Zero-Fee Visa Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, providing a truly free banking card option for all users.

promotions.title: PowerDraw Up to 200% Rebate + Million Dollar Prize Pool
promotions.highlight: 💰 Win up to 200% rebate and share HKD 1 million prize pool
promotions.description: ZA Card users can participate in PowerDraw to win up to 200% rebate on purchases. Additionally, customers receive MillionTix through PowerDraw for a chance to share in a prize pool of HKD 1 million. This promotion encourages spending with ZA Card to maximize chances of winning substantial cashback and prizes.
promotions.cost: Must use ZA Card for eligible transactions

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 20% p.a. 7-Day Time Deposit for New Referred Customers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers referred by existing users can receive two 19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest boost coupons (plus base rate for total 20% p.a.). The first coupon is awarded when depositing ≥ HKD 1,000 within 14 days of account opening, valid for deposits up to HKD 20,000. A second coupon is granted when maintaining HKD 1,000 balance across deposits, funds and stocks, valid for deposits up to HKD 100,000.
promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts with referral codes during the promotion period
promotions.cost: Must deposit ≥ HKD 1,000 for first coupon; must maintain combined balance of HKD 1,000 across deposits, funds and stocks for second coupon

promotions.title: ZA Card StockBack 6th Anniversary 6% Cashback on Coffee
promotions.highlight: ☕ Get 6% stock rebates at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: During ZA Bank's 6th anniversary celebration, customers could earn 6% StockBack rewards when spending at any local coffee merchant using their ZA Card. Qualifying transactions needed to be at least HKD 10 and made directly with the card (not through Alipay or WeChat Pay). The reward cap for special coffee merchant rebates was HKD 50 per user during the promotion period.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; maximum combined special rebates capped at HKD 50 per user
promotions.cost: Minimum spending of HKD 10 per transaction required

promotions.title: ZA Bank 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Round-the-clock customer support every day
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides 24/7 customer service for all users, ensuring assistance is available at any time of day. This always-on support system allows customers to resolve issues, ask questions, and receive guidance regardless of time constraints. The service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to convenient digital banking that overcomes traditional banking limitations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank Refer to Take Out a Loan Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends to ZA Bank loans
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can earn rewards up to HKD 900 by referring friends to apply for loans with ZA Bank. The referral program provides cash incentives when referred friends successfully obtain loan products. Reward amounts vary based on the loan type and amount approved for the referred friend.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers
promotions.cost: Free to participate; referred friends must complete loan application and approval process

promotions.title: Wise Express Remittance Service
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Fast international transfers powered by Wise
promotions.description: ZA Bank has partnered with Wise to offer express remittance services for HKD payments, providing faster international transfers than traditional methods. This service enables customers to send money internationally with competitive exchange rates and transparent fee structures. It complements ZA Bank's suite of global transfer options, including SWIFT transfers to over 140 countries.
promotions.cost: Fees vary by destination and amount

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance Application in as Fast as 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured via smartphone in as little as 3 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a fully digital insurance application process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes via smartphone. Options include life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) with a simplified claims process.

promotions.title: Zero Deposit Requirement for Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 💸 Open an account with zero deposit requirement
promotions.description: ZA Bank allows both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong to open a bank account online with no minimum deposit requirement. This zero-barrier entry makes banking accessible to everyone regardless of their initial deposit amount.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong

promotions.title: 24x7 Currency Exchange
promotions.highlight: ⏰ Exchange currencies anytime with 24/7 availability
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can exchange between 11 currencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week at their preferred rates. This allows users to seize market opportunities at any time and grow their wealth through flexible currency exchange.

promotions.title: Currency Exchange Discount Voucher HKD 126
promotions.highlight: 💱 Get HKD 126 discount on currency exchange
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher as part of the new customer reward package. The voucher is valid for 30 days after receipt and can be used for eligible currency exchange transactions.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: HKD 100 Overseas Remittance Cash Rebate
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Receive HKD 100 rebate on overseas remittance
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 100 overseas remittance cash rebate voucher as part of the welcome package. The voucher can be applied to eligible overseas remittance transactions within 30 days of receipt.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Metal Card Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💳 Win an exclusive metal card worth HKD 1,000
promotions.description: Top 60 users with the highest StockBack points in each of three phases during the 6th anniversary promotion will receive a premium StockBack x ZA Card metal card valued at HKD 1,000.
promotions.quota: Top 60 users per phase; Maximum one card per user during promotion
promotions.cost: Free, but requires active participation in StockBack activities

promotions.title: ZA Card with No Annual or Hidden Fees
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient mobile payments.

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary Coffee Merchant Promotion
promotions.highlight: ☕ 6% stock rewards at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: Customers can earn 6% stock rewards on eligible transactions at all local coffee merchants when spending with their ZA Card during the promotion period. Maximum reward is capped at HKD 50 per customer combining both 6% and 12% offers.
promotions.quota: Maximum HKD 50 combined reward per customer

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals at Visa ATMs in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 💵 Free cash withdrawals at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong
promotions.description: ZA Card holders can withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs throughout Hong Kong. This permanent feature allows customers to access their money without incurring withdrawal fees at supported ATMs.

promotions.title: Open an Account in as Fast as 2 Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Quick and easy account opening in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that can be completed in as fast as 2 minutes when no extra information is required. This service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong.

promotions.title: ZA Credit Loan Referral Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Invite friends to apply for loans at ZA Bank and receive cash rewards up to HKD 900 when they successfully take out a loan. The more friends you refer, the more rewards you can earn.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance in 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via smartphone
promotions.description: Complete the insurance application process in as fast as 3 minutes via your smartphone. Choose from various insurance products including life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) options.
promotions.cost: Insurance premiums vary by product and coverage

promotions.title: ZA Bank Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees
promotions.highlight: 📈 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees
promotions.description: Trade stocks with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees. Platform fees as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction. Trade directly with your HKD or USD deposits in your ZA Bank account.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank investment account holders
promotions.cost: Platform fee starting from USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: New Customer Welcome Reward and StockBack Bonus
promotions.highlight: 🔥 New users enjoy additional 1% stock rewards for a total of 2.5% cashback
promotions.description: New ZA Bank users can enjoy an additional 1% stock rewards on their first HKD 10,000 of eligible spending within 30 days of account opening. This bonus stacks with the 1.5% regular stock rewards for a total of 2.5% stock cashback.
promotions.quota: New users only, for the first HKD 10,000 of eligible transactions
promotions.cost: Minimum transaction amount of HKD 10 required

promotions.title: 0 Brokerage and 0 Custody Fee Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 🏦 0 commission and 0 custody fees on all HK stock trades
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18 per transaction. This permanent feature allows unlimited trading without paying traditional brokerage commissions, significantly reducing trading costs.
promotions.quota: All users with active stock trading accounts
promotions.cost: Platform fee from HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Platform Fee for New Crypto Customers
promotions.highlight: 🪙 $0 platform fee for crypto trading for first 90 days
promotions.description: New customers can enjoy $0 platform fee for cryptocurrency trading for the first 90 days after account opening. Trade 24/7 directly with HKD or USD deposits.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Hong Kong Stocks Trading Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🏆 Up to HKD 1,500 cash rewards for new stock trading customers
promotions.description: New customers who activate Hong Kong stocks trading can receive up to HKD 500 cash rewards through ZA Quest, plus up to HKD 1,000 cash rebate when buying stocks. Enjoy 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.

promotions.title: Hong Kong's No.1 Digital Bank
promotions.highlight: 🏆 First digital bank in Hong Kong with highest user base and deposits
promotions.description: As the first digital bank to launch in Hong Kong, ZA Bank had the highest number of users and customer deposits among the city's eight digital banks as of 30 June 2024. ZA Bank offers 24x7 banking services with convenient digital features.

promotions.title: Refer a Friend for Loan Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Earn up to HKD 900 by referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Existing customers can earn up to HKD 900 in rewards for successfully referring friends who take out loans with ZA Bank. This incentive program rewards customers for bringing in new loan customers.
promotions.quota: All existing ZA Bank account holders

promotions.title: HKD 1,000 Monthly Fee Savings on Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 💰 Save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading fees compared to traditional brokers
promotions.description: ZA Bank's stock trading service can save customers up to HKD 1,000 in monthly fees compared to traditional brokers. This calculation is based on making one trade per trading day (approximately 20 trades per month) with zero commission, zero custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.
promotions.cost: Platform fees apply (from HKD 18 per transaction)

promotions.title: 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🧑‍💼 Round-the-clock customer support
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers 24x7 customer service support to all users. Banking services are always available regardless of time of day, with full customer service access.

promotions.title: Customer Referral Program - Referrer Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🤝 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open accounts
promotions.description: ZA Bank's customer referral program rewards users for referring friends to open accounts. Referrers can earn various rewards based on the number of successful referrals, with top referrers eligible for up to HKD 10,000 per phase across 9 phases of the campaign.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Brokerage & 0% Custody Fees for Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 📈 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees for Hong Kong stocks
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with zero commission and zero custody fees. Platform fee is as low as HKD 18 per transaction, allowing users to save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading costs compared to traditional brokers.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank users with activated stock trading services
promotions.cost: Platform fee as low as HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: New User HKD 500 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💵 Get up to HKD 500 cash reward when opening a new account
promotions.description: Selected customers can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards when opening a new ZA Bank account. Customers can complete specific tasks in ZA Quest after successful account opening to receive the reward.
promotions.quota: Selected new customers only; not applicable to customers who opened accounts through referral programs or have received other new customer gifts

promotions.title: New Account HKD 2,026 Welcome Reward
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Get rewards worth HKD 2,026 plus 2.5% stock rebate
promotions.description: New users who open an account using a referral code can receive rewards worth HKD 2,026 including fund position rebate vouchers and stock cash rebate vouchers. Additionally, they can enjoy 2.5% stock rebate on eligible purchases.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Account Opening in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open an account in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that allows customers to open an account in as little as 2 minutes. The service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong with zero deposit requirements.

promotions.title: Fund Redemption Fee Waiver
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Redemption fee waivers for all funds
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers who have activated fund trading services can enjoy redemption fee waivers for all funds until July 31, 2026. This allows investors to redeem their fund investments without paying any redemption fees.
promotions.quota: All retail banking users who have activated fund trading services

promotions.title: ZA Bank Payment Connect Cross-Border Transfer
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Fee-free real-time transfers between Mainland China and Hong Kong
promotions.description: Send money between Mainland China and Hong Kong in real-time with zero fees using Payment Connect. Instant cross-border transfers without any handling charges.

promotions.title: New Stock Trading Customer Cash Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Up to HKD 1,500 in cash rewards for new stock traders
promotions.description: New users can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards for opening an account, plus up to HKD 1,000 in cash rebates for buying stocks. This offer is specifically for Hong Kong stock trading customers.
promotions.cost: Must buy stocks to qualify for portion of rewards

promotions.title: Second 20% p.a. Time Deposit for Multi-Product Usage
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Additional 20% p.a. time deposit for using multiple products
promotions.description: New referred customers who hold deposits, funds, and stocks with a total balance of at least HKD 1,000 within 14 days of opening an account can receive an additional +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest rate booster coupon, providing a second opportunity to enjoy 20% p.a. interest.
promotions.quota: New referred customers using multiple products

products.fees: Standard credit card fees apply, specific details not provided in the source

The service is available 24/7, allowing customers to apply and receive funds at any time. Additional documentation may be required in certain cases for approval.

features: Loan amounts up to 12x monthly salary

products.fees: No account management fees

Money Safe is accessible through the EleBank App.

features: Same interest rates as regular savings/time deposits

features: Protected under Hong Kong's Deposit Protection Scheme
products.fees: No information provided about account maintenance fees
